title: Investment authority change log
description: Creation, change, expiry and revocation of every delegation and mandate with approvers.

title: Regulatory boundary legal opinion
description: Counsel opinion on Investment Advisers Act and state adviser status of Unbound's relay and reporting functions.

title: Allocation election record
description: Election, policy evaluation, sponsor decision, relayed instruction and manager confirmation per change.

title: Drift exception report
description: Funds or pools outside tolerance with age and resolution.

title: Valuation record
description: Inputs, sources, high-water marks, rule and code version, tolerance result, reviewer or delegation reference, publication event.

title: Investment committee delegation record
description: Approved tolerances, pricing sources, scope and review date.

title: Valuation correction case
description: Original and corrected values, cause class, impact analysis, materiality decision, remediation and approvals.

title: Investment policy compliance report
description: Limits evaluated, breaches, exceptions approved and their expiry.

title: Liquidity stress model record
description: Model version, assumptions, outflow data and approved buffer.

title: Manager performance and cost report
description: Folio report with declared methodology, gross and net returns, benchmarks and all fee layers.

title: Investment governance decision record
description: Manager selection, scope, policy approvals and review minutes references.

title: Illiquid valuation file
description: Methodology, appraiser or source, uncertainty range, approver and expiry per asset.
